notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds column); business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement (p6, Totals column). Intergovernmental 92,111 split using the budgetary comparison schedule actuals (p7): highway allocation 59,743 + municipal equalization 17,637 + motor vehicle fees 3,965 + other intergovernmental 10,766 = 92,111 (Street fund 81,345 = first three). Business-type measure recorded as cash because the modified cash net position has no liabilities (net position equals cash). Business-type beginning 92,769 per p6 (p2 shows 92,770 and change 24,639 due to rounding). Receipts and disbursements totals for business-type are computed. Detail is the all-fund budgetary comparison (p7), mixing governmental and business-type; fund_type assigned per line; its printed totals include transfers (14,500 each side) which appear as signed other financing items. Printed total disbursements 632,793 in that schedule includes the 14,500 transfer as spending. Statement of Activities (p2) is not itemized further. Detail Interest 3,448 (p7) split by fund type per p4 (2,391) and p6 (1,057). Read pages 1-7 of 7. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule.
